name: doc2do
description: Turn confusing documents into source-backed action plans with Gemini.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @doc2do/contracts && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @doc2do/api" "npm run dev -w @doc2do/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @doc2do/contracts && npm run build -w @doc2do/web && npm run build -w @doc2do/api
scripts.test: npm run build -w @doc2do/contracts && npm run test -w @doc2do/api && npm run test -w @doc2do/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @doc2do/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @doc2do/web && npm run typecheck -w @doc2do/api
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @doc2do/web && npm run lint -w @doc2do/api
